prompt: How many months, rounded to the nearest whole number, did it take to construct the tallest building in the world as of January 1, 2024?
answer:
The tallest building in the world on January 1, 2024, was the **Burj Khalifa**.

Using its construction dates—**January 6, 2004, to October 1, 2009**—construction took approximately **69 months**, rounded to the nearest whole month.
